ideas.title: Following the Money: A Deep Dive into the Minnesota Fraud Scandal
ideas.description: This story would investigate the flow of funds in the Minnesota fraud scandal and identify potential misuse or lack of oversight.
questions: How did the funds flow in the Minnesota fraud scandal?
What oversight mechanisms were in place to prevent misuse of funds?
ideas.insight: This story would require a deep dive into the financial records and transactions involved in the scandal. It would also involve interviewing key players and whistleblowers to gain insight into the events leading up to the scandal.

ideas.title: The Impact of Medicaid Funding on Low-Income Families
ideas.description: This story would investigate the impact of the Trump administration's decision to freeze Medicaid funding on low-income families in Minnesota.
questions: How have low-income families been affected by the freeze on Medicaid funding?
What alternatives are available to these families?
ideas.insight: This story would require analyzing data on Medicaid enrollment and usage, as well as interviewing low-income families and healthcare providers to gain insight into the human impact of the funding freeze.
